name: Again
original_name: AGAIN FBI 超心理捜査官
source: In Again, an interactive crime novel developed by Cing, we play as FBI Agent J, the sole survivor of a string of murder cases that took place 19 years ago, who must use his special "past vision" skill (it allows the player to see locations in different times in order to notice the differences and solve puzzles) to investigate a new series of homicides linked to the past ones and to the mysterious serial killer Providence.
translation: 《AGAIN FBI超心理搜查官》是Cing开发的互动犯罪小说。玩家扮演FBI探员J——19年前一连串凶杀案的唯一幸存者。他必须运用特殊能力‘过去视’，观察同一地点在不同时期的景象、找出差异并解开谜题，调查一系列与往昔案件及神秘连环杀手‘天意’有关的新凶案。
